key: CRAUDBURRY: You think you can simply stroll into anybody's house and do as you please?
en: CRAUDBURRY: You think you can simply stroll into anybody's house and do as you please?
ja: クラウドバリー: 人の家に勝手に入り込んで、好き放題できるとでも思っているの?

key: Out with you, street scum!
en: Out with you, street scum!
ja: 出ておいき、この路上のクズが!

key: There's nothing for you here!
en: There's nothing for you here!
ja: あなたにここでするようなことなど、何もないわ!

key: Shoo!
en: Shoo!
ja: しっ、行きなさい!

key: CRAUDBURRY: Wait a second...
en: CRAUDBURRY: Wait a second...
ja: クラウドバリー: ちょっと待って……

key: That's the one!
en: That's the one!
ja: その者よ!

key: That's the one, officer!
en: That's the one, officer!
ja: それよ、警官!

key: OFFICER: I beg your pardon?
en: OFFICER: I beg your pardon?
ja: 警官: 何とおっしゃいました?

key: CRAUDBURRY: That's the one who stole my Pokémon!
en: CRAUDBURRY: That's the one who stole my Pokémon!
ja: クラウドバリー: それが、わたしのポケモンを盗んだ者よ!

key: OFFICER: ...\PN?
en: OFFICER: ...\PN?
ja: 警官: ……\PN?

key: I'm afraid you must be mistaken, lady; \PN would never do something like that.
en: I'm afraid you must be mistaken, lady; \PN would never do something like that.
ja: 失礼ですが、お間違いかと。\PNがそんなことをするとは思えません。

key: Why, \PN even rescued me when I was locked in a cage in the Rhodochrine Jungle!
en: Why, \PN even rescued me when I was locked in a cage in the Rhodochrine Jungle!
ja: それどころか、\PNはロドクラインジャングルのおりに閉じ込められていた私を助けてくれたんですよ!

key: And rescued the rest of the police force, too!
en: And rescued the rest of the police force, too!
ja: それに、他の警察隊員たちも救ってくれました!

key: Look, I'm sorry, but you've got the wrong person.
en: Look, I'm sorry, but you've got the wrong person.
ja: あの、申し訳ありませんが、人違いですよ。

key: CRAUDBURRY: I know what I saw!
en: CRAUDBURRY: I know what I saw!
ja: クラウドバリー: わたしはこの目で見たのよ!

key: OFFICER: Uh huh.
en: OFFICER: Uh huh.
ja: 警官: はあ。

key: I'm sorry, but there's no way I can incriminate \PN just because they happened to walk in the door when you were raving about it.
en: I'm sorry, but there's no way I can incriminate \PN just because they happened to walk in the door when you were raving about it.
ja: 申し訳ありませんが、あなたがわめいているときにたまたまドアから入ってきたというだけで、\PNを罪に問うことなどできません。

key: OFFICER: That person there?
en: OFFICER: That person there?
ja: 警官: あの人ですか?

key: Why, they don't look like a thug at all.
en: Why, they don't look like a thug at all.
ja: いやいや、まったく悪党には見えませんが。

key: CRAUDBURRY: I saw it with my own two eyes!
en: CRAUDBURRY: I saw it with my own two eyes!
ja: クラウドバリー: この目でしっかり見たのよ!

key: No doubt, that's the one that walked out after taking my Pokémon!
en: No doubt, that's the one that walked out after taking my Pokémon!
ja: 間違いないわ、それがわたしのポケモンを盗んで出ていった者よ!

key: OFFICER: I'm afraid you're mistaken, lady.
en: OFFICER: I'm afraid you're mistaken, lady.
ja: 警官: 申し訳ありませんが、お間違いですよ。

key: See, we already know you were a target of a conflict between the Aqua and Magma Gangs.
en: See, we already know you were a target of a conflict between the Aqua and Magma Gangs.
ja: というのも、あなたがアクア団とマグマ団の抗争の標的になっていたことは、すでにわかっているんです。

key: And see, we already have all of their profiles on record.
en: And see, we already have all of their profiles on record.
ja: それに、彼らの記録は全員分すでに把握しています。

key: I can tell you for a fact that this person isn't among them.
en: I can tell you for a fact that this person isn't among them.
ja: この方が彼らの一員ではないことは、確かに申し上げられます。

key: Doesn't even look like the type.
en: Doesn't even look like the type.
ja: そういうタイプにも見えませんし。

key: Now listen, Ms. Craudburry, you can't just go accusing any stranger who happens to walk into your house.
en: Now listen, Ms. Craudburry, you can't just go accusing any stranger who happens to walk into your house.
ja: いいですか、クラウドバリーさん、たまたま家に入ってきた見知らぬ人を、何でもかんでも犯人扱いするわけにはいかないんですよ。

key: CRAUDBURRY: You're calling me a liar?!
en: CRAUDBURRY: You're calling me a liar?!
ja: クラウドバリー: わたしをうそつき呼ばわりするの?!

key: How DARE you insinuate such a thing, you ungrateful, wretched bum!
en: How DARE you insinuate such a thing, you ungrateful, wretched bum!
ja: よくもそんなことをほのめかせるわね、この恩知らずな、みじめな役立たずが!

key: I want to talk to your superior!
en: I want to talk to your superior!
ja: あなたの上司と話をさせなさい!

key: No! I'm going to write a LETTER!
en: No! I'm going to write a LETTER!
ja: いいえ! 手紙を書いてやるわ!

key: And then you'll be fired!
en: And then you'll be fired!
ja: それであなたはクビになるのよ!

key: And then you'll starve to death!
en: And then you'll starve to death!
ja: それで飢え死にするといいわ!

key: God, what has this city gone to!?
en: God, what has this city gone to!?
ja: ああ、この街は一体どうなってしまったの?!

key: SHIT.
en: SHIT.
ja: クソだわ。

key: UTTER SHIT, that's what!
en: UTTER SHIT, that's what!
ja: 完全なクソよ、それだけのことだわ!

key: NO WONDER things are BLOWING UP HERE and THERE and EVERYWHERE!
en: NO WONDER things are BLOWING UP HERE and THERE and EVERYWHERE!
ja: だからあちこちで、そこら中で、爆発事件なんか起きるのよ!

key: The authorities are a bunch of COMMON CROOKS!
en: The authorities are a bunch of COMMON CROOKS!
ja: お上なんて、ただのならず者の集まりじゃない!

key: SCUM!
en: SCUM!
ja: クズ!

key: BILE!
en: BILE!
ja: 胆汁!

key: SNAKES!
en: SNAKES!
ja: 蛇よ!

key: OFFICER: Oi.
en: OFFICER: Oi.
ja: 警官: おい。

key: No wonder the others insisted on drawing straws to see who had to take this case...
en: No wonder the others insisted on drawing straws to see who had to take this case...
ja: どうりで皆、この案件を誰が担当するかでくじを引きたがったわけだ……

key: CRAUDBURRY: Your city lives! Decades it's thrived on depending on YOUR protection, and you treat it like GARBAGE!
en: CRAUDBURRY: Your city lives! Decades it's thrived on depending on YOUR protection, and you treat it like GARBAGE!
ja: クラウドバリー: あなたの街は生きているのよ! 何十年もあなたたちの保護に頼って栄えてきたのに、それをゴミみたいに扱うなんて!

key: So that's what this is, the city of GARBAGE.
en: So that's what this is, the city of GARBAGE.
ja: つまりこれが、ゴミの街ってわけね。

key: So do whatever you want-- go on, do it!
en: So do whatever you want-- go on, do it!
ja: だから好きにすればいいわ――さあ、やりなさいよ!

key: It won't affect the city of SLIME, the city of FILTH, the city of PUTRESCENCE!
en: It won't affect the city of SLIME, the city of FILTH, the city of PUTRESCENCE!
ja: このヘドロの街、汚物の街、腐敗の街には、何の影響もないんだから!

key: BOO!
en: BOO!
ja: ブーッ!

key: BOO!!
en: BOO!!
ja: ブーッ!!

key: RUBBISH!
en: RUBBISH!
ja: ガラクタ!

key: MUCK!
en: MUCK!
ja: 泥沼!

key: FILTH!
en: FILTH!
ja: 汚物!

key: SLIME!
en: SLIME!
ja: ヘドロ!

key: BOO!!!
en: BOO!!!
ja: ブーッ!!!

key: CRAUDBURRY: Get out of my sight.
en: CRAUDBURRY: Get out of my sight.
ja: クラウドバリー: わたしの前から消えなさい。

key: CRAUDBURRY: So the filth has followed me back here, has it?
en: CRAUDBURRY: So the filth has followed me back here, has it?
ja: クラウドバリー: あの汚物が、わたしをここまで追ってきたというの?

key: Do you intend to desecrate my house again? Shit on my life once more?
en: Do you intend to desecrate my house again? Shit on my life once more?
ja: またわたしの家をけがすつもり? もう一度わたしの人生に汚物を浴びせるつもり?

key: I could pay the dogs in 7th Street to kill your family if I wanted!
en: I could pay the dogs in 7th Street to kill your family if I wanted!
ja: その気になれば、7番街の犬どもに金を払って、あなたの家族を殺させることだってできるのよ!

key: Do not cross me, wretched pigling!
en: Do not cross me, wretched pigling!
ja: わたしに逆らわないことね、この哀れな豚っ子が!

key: If you won't leave, I'll MAKE you leave!
en: If you won't leave, I'll MAKE you leave!
ja: 出ていかないなら、無理やり出ていかせてやるわ!

key: After the last little incident with your pack of flea- bitten hounds, I decided to invest in a bit of self- defense.
en: After the last little incident with your pack of flea- bitten hounds, I decided to invest in a bit of self- defense.
ja: この前の、あなたたちのノミだらけの犬ころ騒ぎのあと、多少の自衛に投資することにしたのよ。

key: I've already bought the best Pokémon 7th Street has to offer, and they'll make you regret the day you crawled into this world!
en: I've already bought the best Pokémon 7th Street has to offer, and they'll make you regret the day you crawled into this world!
ja: 7番街で手に入る最高のポケモンはもう買ってあるわ、あなたがこの世に生まれてきたことを後悔させてあげる!

key: ...BAAAAAH!
en: ...BAAAAAH!
ja: ……バァァァァ!

key: CRAUDBURRY: GYAAAAAAH!!!
en: CRAUDBURRY: GYAAAAAAH!!!
ja: クラウドバリー: ギャアアアアア!!!

key: WORTHLESS. These Pokémon are WORTHLESS!
en: WORTHLESS. These Pokémon are WORTHLESS!
ja: 役立たずだわ。このポケモンたち、役立たずよ!

key: I paid good money for these-- that shady vendor, that treacherous PIG!
en: I paid good money for these-- that shady vendor, that treacherous PIG!
ja: こんなにお金を払ったのに――あの怪しい業者、あの卑劣な豚め!

key: I should have him ARRESTED.
en: I should have him ARRESTED.
ja: あいつを逮捕させてやるべきだわ。

key: ARCHER: Sounds like a bad plan.
en: ARCHER: Sounds like a bad plan.
ja: アーチャー: それは、まずい考えだな。

key: MAXWELL: As if you would.
en: MAXWELL: As if you would.
ja: マクスウェル: できるもんかよ。

key: CRAUDBURRY: AAAAGH! Get out of my house!
en: CRAUDBURRY: AAAAGH! Get out of my house!
ja: クラウドバリー: ああああ! わたしの家から出ていって!

key: ARCHER: Now why would I do that?
en: ARCHER: Now why would I do that?
ja: アーチャー: さて、なぜそうしなければならない?

key: Will you force me out with your fearsome illegal Pokémon?
en: Will you force me out with your fearsome illegal Pokémon?
ja: あなたの恐ろしい違法ポケモンで、私を追い出すつもりか?

key: Indeed, you could not possibly have that vendor arrested; you willfully participated in illegal trade yourself.
en: Indeed, you could not possibly have that vendor arrested; you willfully participated in illegal trade yourself.
ja: それに、あの業者を逮捕させることなど、そもそもできまい。あなた自身も進んで違法取引に加担していたのだからな。

key: You'll ruin yourself if you try to do anything.
en: You'll ruin yourself if you try to do anything.
ja: 何かしようとすれば、自分の身を滅ぼすだけだ。

key: MAXWELL: Pfft, yeah, right.
en: MAXWELL: Pfft, yeah, right.
ja: マクスウェル: ふん、よく言うぜ。

key: You gonna cut us down with your super scary Pokémon?
en: You gonna cut us down with your super scary Pokémon?
ja: そのすげえ恐ろしいポケモンで、俺たちを切り倒すってか?

key: Oh, wait! They're down for the count. You're out of cards to play, baby.
en: Oh, wait! They're down for the count. You're out of cards to play, baby.
ja: おっと、待てよ! もうノックダウンしちまってるじゃねえか。手札切れだな、ベイビー。

key: Anyway, you aren't gonna be arrestin' anyone.
en: Anyway, you aren't gonna be arrestin' anyone.
ja: とにかく、あんたは誰も逮捕できやしねえよ。

key: You're the criminal here, buying Pokémon you knew were illegally traded?
en: You're the criminal here, buying Pokémon you knew were illegally traded?
ja: 違法取引だってわかってて買ったんだ、犯罪者はあんたの方だろ?

key: You'd be putting yourself in jail.
en: You'd be putting yourself in jail.
ja: 自分をろうやにぶち込むことになるだけだぜ。

key: CRAUDBURRY: How DARE you!
en: CRAUDBURRY: How DARE you!
ja: クラウドバリー: よくもそんな口を!

key: ARCHER: So that's just it.
en: ARCHER: So that's just it.
ja: アーチャー: というわけだ。

key: Our terms are as such:
en: Our terms are as such:
ja: 私たちの要求はこうだ。

key: Firstly, you will stop your fiendish screeching.
en: Firstly, you will stop your fiendish screeching.
ja: まず、その悪魔じみた金切り声をやめること。

key: Secondly, you will never return to 7th Street.
en: Secondly, you will never return to 7th Street.
ja: 次に、二度と7番街には戻らないこと。

key: Are we clear?
en: Are we clear?
ja: わかったか?

key: MAXWELL: Shut your trap and listen, lady.
en: MAXWELL: Shut your trap and listen, lady.
ja: マクスウェル: 口を閉じてよく聞けよ、あんた。

key: Your days of bullying the underworld are over.
en: Your days of bullying the underworld are over.
ja: あんたが裏社会をいじめ回す日々は終わりだ。

key: If I, or any of my buddies ever see you on 7th Street, you aren't gonna like what happens.
en: If I, or any of my buddies ever see you on 7th Street, you aren't gonna like what happens.
ja: もし俺や仲間の誰かが、7番街であんたを見かけたら、ろくなことにはならねえぞ。

key: Capiche?
en: Capiche?
ja: わかったか?

key: CRAUDBURRY: Grrrrrr...
en: CRAUDBURRY: Grrrrrr...
ja: クラウドバリー: ぐぬぬぬ……

key: ARCHER: Agreed, then. \PN, let's go.
en: ARCHER: Agreed, then. \PN, let's go.
ja: アーチャー: 合意だな。\PN、行こう。

key: MAXWELL: I'll take that as a noise of pure, willful obedience.
en: MAXWELL: I'll take that as a noise of pure, willful obedience.
ja: マクスウェル: それを、心からの従順の返事として受け取っておくぜ。

key: Well, that's that. Come on, \PN.
en: Well, that's that. Come on, \PN.
ja: さて、これで片づいたな。行くぞ、\PN。

key: CRAUDBURRY: RRRRRRRR.
en: CRAUDBURRY: RRRRRRRR.
ja: クラウドバリー: ぐるるるる。

key: I don't know what to do!
en: I don't know what to do!
ja: どうしたらいいかわからないの!

key: My little boy just up and vanished!
en: My little boy just up and vanished!
ja: うちの息子が、突然いなくなってしまって!

key: Where could he have gotten to?
en: Where could he have gotten to?
ja: 一体どこへ行ってしまったの?

key: What? You found a kid who was cornered by some Pokémon?
en: What? You found a kid who was cornered by some Pokémon?
ja: え? ポケモンに追い詰められてた子供を見つけたの?

key: That must be my boy!
en: That must be my boy!
ja: それ、うちの子に違いないわ!

key: But if he already came home?
en: But if he already came home?
ja: でも、もしもう家に帰ってきていたら?

key: He clearly hasn't gotten here yet.
en: He clearly hasn't gotten here yet.
ja: 明らかに、まだここには着いていないわ。

key: Oh no! Something must have happened along the way!
en: Oh no! Something must have happened along the way!
ja: ああ! 途中で何かあったに違いないわ!

key: I know it's a lot to ask, but could you go look for him? I'm so worried, and I can't go far myself.
en: I know it's a lot to ask, but could you go look for him?  I'm so worried, and I can't go far myself.
ja: 無理を承知でお願いするけど、探しに行ってもらえない? すごく心配で、自分では遠くまで行けないの。

key: Please, I'm begging you!
en: Please, I'm begging you!
ja: お願い、頼むわ!

key: The last I saw, he was playing with some Pokémon near the bottom of the wall...
en: The last I saw, he was playing with some Pokémon near the bottom of the wall...
ja: 最後に見たとき、あの子は壁の下の方でポケモンと遊んでいたの……

key: And then he was gone, just like that!
en: And then he was gone, just like that!
ja: それで、あっという間にいなくなってしまって!

key: I've heard stories of children being spirited away, but surely he must be somewhere between here and Beryl Bridge!
en: I've heard stories of children being spirited away, but surely he must be somewhere between here and Beryl Bridge!
ja: 子供が神隠しにあったなんて話も聞くけど、きっとここからベリル大橋の間のどこかにいるはずよ!

key: Right?
en: Right?
ja: そうよね?

key: ...Right???
en: ...Right???
ja: ……そうよね???

key: You did it! You found my baby! I can never thank you enough.
en: You did it! You found my baby! I can never thank you enough.
ja: やってくれたのね! うちの赤ちゃんを見つけてくれて! お礼の言葉もないわ。

key: I know it's not much, but do you have any use for a Department Store Sticker?
en: I know it's not much, but do you have any use for a Department Store Sticker?
ja: たいしたものじゃないけど、デパートシール、使い道あるかしら?

key: Just consider it a token of my much deeper gratitude...
en: Just consider it a token of my much deeper gratitude...
ja: もっと深い感謝の印だと思ってちょうだい……

key: ...And to be perfectly honest, I never wish to see this Pokémon again in my life.
en: ...And to be perfectly honest, I never wish to see this Pokémon again in my life.
ja: ……それに正直に言うと、このポケモンとは、もう二度と顔を合わせたくないの。

key: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Drifloon!
en: \PN obtained a Department Store Sticker: Drifloon!
ja: \PNはデパートシール「フワンテ」を手に入れた!

key: Oh, you don't have a Membership Card? That's too bad.
en: Oh, you don't have a Membership Card? That's too bad.
ja: あら、会員カードをお持ちじゃないの? それは残念。

key: You simply must go get one! And when you do, come back to me!
en: You simply must go get one! And when you do, come back to me!
ja: ぜひ手に入れてきてね! それで、また戻ってきてちょうだい!

key: Hey... Haven't I seen you before?
en: Hey... Haven't I seen you before?
ja: あれ……前にどこかで会ったっけ?

key: I know! You were that Trainer from TV!
en: I know! You were that Trainer from TV!
ja: そうだ! テレビに出てたトレーナーさんだ!

key: Gossip Gardevoir was talking all about you, and how you've been all over the place fighting the evil Team Meteor!
en: Gossip Gardevoir was talking all about you, and how you've been all over the place fighting the evil Team Meteor!
ja: ゴシップサーナイトが、あなたのこと色々話してたよ、あちこちで悪のメテオ団と戦ってるって!

key: It's so cool!
en: It's so cool!
ja: すごくかっこいい!

key: Can I get your autograph?!
en: Can I get your autograph?!
ja: サイン、もらえます?!

key: I don't have much to sign...
en: I don't have much to sign...
ja: サインするもの、あんまり持ってないんだけど……

key: Um, how about this Sticker?
en: Um, how about this Sticker?
ja: ええと、このシールでどう?

key: No, that's silly. Actually, just take it!
en: No, that's silly. Actually, just take it!
ja: ううん、それはバカげてる。ていうか、あげちゃう!

key: Yeah, take it! I'll be pleased as punch to help out a celebrity like you.
en: Yeah, take it! I'll be pleased as punch to help out a celebrity like you.
ja: うん、受け取って! あなたみたいな有名人の力になれるなんて、すごくうれしいから。

key: Oh, you don't have a Membership Card?
en: Oh, you don't have a Membership Card?
ja: あら、会員カードをお持ちじゃないの?

key: Thank you so much for everything!
en: Thank you so much for everything!
ja: 本当に、色々ありがとう!

key: Someday, I'll be as strong as you!
en: Someday, I'll be as strong as you!
ja: いつか、あなたみたいに強くなるんだ!

key: Pokémon Trainers are so cool!
en: Pokémon Trainers are so cool!
ja: ポケモントレーナーって、すごくかっこいい!

key: I wanna get a Pokémon and challenge the Gym League!
en: I wanna get a Pokémon and challenge the Gym League!
ja: ポケモンを手に入れて、ジムリーグに挑戦したいな!

key: I wonder what the Champion is like?
en: I wonder what the Champion is like?
ja: チャンピオンって、どんな人なんだろう?

key: ARCHER: Welcome, \PN. I'm glad you came.
en: ARCHER: Welcome, \PN. I'm glad you came.
ja: アーチャー: ようこそ、\PN。来てくれてうれしいよ。

key: DEFACTO: Mannie and Razzy have been appropriated to guardianship of headquarters during the operation.
en: DEFACTO: Mannie and Razzy have been appropriated to guardianship of headquarters during the operation.
ja: デファクト: マニーとラジーは、作戦中の本部の警護に充てられている。

key: ARCHER: Meaning it's just the four of us, so listen up.
en: ARCHER: Meaning it's just the four of us, so listen up.
ja: アーチャー: つまり、我々四人だけということだ。よく聞け。

key: Here's the situation. Magma Gang's got their eye on a certain rare Pokémon owned by one of Lapis' wealthiest residents.
en: Here's the situation. Magma Gang's got their eye on a certain rare Pokémon owned by one of Lapis' wealthiest residents.
ja: 状況はこうだ。マグマ団が、ラピスの富豪の一人が所有する、あるレアなポケモンに目をつけている。

key: Knowing them, they'll probably try to frame us when they steal it, so we have to bust in there and stop that from happening.
en: Knowing them, they'll probably try to frame us when they steal it, so we have to bust in there and stop that from happening.
ja: 奴らのことだ、盗んだ上でこちらに罪をなすりつけようとするだろう。だから、押し入ってそれを阻止しなければならない。

key: If it comes down to it, we'll take the Pokémon for ourselves.
en: If it comes down to it, we'll take the Pokémon for ourselves.
ja: いざとなれば、そのポケモンは我々が頂く。

key: DEFACTO: The aforementioned target is identified as Ms. Ignosia Craudburry.
en: DEFACTO: The aforementioned target is identified as Ms. Ignosia Craudburry.
ja: デファクト: 先ほどの標的は、イグノーシャ・クラウドバリー氏と判明している。

key: I believe the proper word to describe her would be 'spinster'.
en: I believe the proper word to describe her would be 'spinster'.
ja: 彼女を表す適切な言葉は「行き遅れ」だろう。

key: Or 'hag'.
en: Or 'hag'.
ja: あるいは「老いぼれ」。

key: Or 'putrid witch who called the city police on me just because I looked at her for more than a millisecond while passing by on the street'.
en: Or 'putrid witch who called the city police on me just because I looked at her for more than a millisecond while passing by on the street'.
ja: あるいは「通りすがりに一瞬より長く目を合わせただけで、市警察を呼んだ腐りきった魔女」。

key: Wretched old lady, if you know her.
en: Wretched old lady, if you know her.
ja: 彼女を知っているなら、みじめな老婦人だ。

key: Actually, she's wretched even if you don't know her, but you've got the better end of that bargain.
en: Actually, she's wretched even if you don't know her, but you've got the better end of that bargain.
ja: 実際は、知らなくてもみじめな人物なのだが、知らずに済む方がまだましというものだ。

key: PIERCE: Nobody cares, DeFacto.
en: PIERCE: Nobody cares, DeFacto.
ja: ピアース: 誰も興味ないぜ、デファクト。

key: DEFACTO: I was simply informing our newest attendant of the content of her character.
en: DEFACTO: I was simply informing our newest attendant of the content of her character.
ja: デファクト: 私はただ、新入りに彼女の人となりを伝えていただけだ。

key: ARCHER: Anyway, our reputation and our safety are at stake here!
en: ARCHER: Anyway, our reputation and our safety are at stake here!
ja: アーチャー: とにかく、我々の評判と安全がかかっているんだ!

key: Let's move out and put an end to Magma's schemes!
en: Let's move out and put an end to Magma's schemes!
ja: 出発するぞ、マグマの企みに終止符を打とう!

key: DEFACTO: Affirmative.
en: DEFACTO: Affirmative.
ja: デファクト: 了解した。

key: ARCHER: Meet us there, \PN. We'll be waiting.
en: ARCHER: Meet us there, \PN. We'll be waiting.
ja: アーチャー: そこで落ち合おう、\PN。待っている。

key: MAXWELL: Glad you could make it, \PN.
en: MAXWELL: Glad you could make it, \PN.
ja: マクスウェル: 来てくれて助かったぜ、\PN。

key: DARM: Nihil and Kriz stayed back to guard base, so this is it for our power crew for this operation.
en: DARM: Nihil and Kriz stayed back to guard base, so this is it for our power crew for this operation.
ja: ダーム: ニヒルとクリズは基地の警護に残った、今回の作戦の主力はこれで全部だ。

key: Hoo-hah!
en: Hoo-hah!
ja: フーハー!

key: MAXWELL: Okay, so here's what's going down.
en: MAXWELL: Okay, so here's what's going down.
ja: マクスウェル: よし、それじゃ状況を説明するぜ。

key: Aqua Gang is planning to steal a certain rare Pokémon from one of the richest women in Lapis.
en: Aqua Gang is planning to steal a certain rare Pokémon from one of the richest women in Lapis.
ja: アクア団が、ラピスで一番の金持ち女から、あるレアなポケモンを盗む計画を立ててる。

key: Our job is to get in there and make sure they get nothing.
en: Our job is to get in there and make sure they get nothing.
ja: 俺たちの仕事は、そこに乗り込んで奴らに何も持たせないことだ。

key: We steal it right out from under their noses.
en: We steal it right out from under their noses.
ja: 奴らの鼻先から、まんまと横取りしてやるのさ。

key: BREAK: The target in question is Ms. Craudburry.
en: BREAK: The target in question is Ms. Craudburry.
ja: ブレーク: 今回の標的はクラウドバリーさんだよ。

key: I mean, really. One time when I was working retail, she came in and started complaining about how dusty the shop was right after we had just--
en: I mean, really. One time when I was working retail, she came in and started complaining about how dusty the shop was right after we had just--
ja: というか、マジでさ。俺が小売の仕事してたとき、あの人来て、ちょうど掃除したばかりの店がほこりっぽいって文句言い始めて――

key: MAXWELL: Break.
en: MAXWELL: Break.
ja: マクスウェル: ブレーク。

key: BREAK: Sorry, boss.
en: BREAK: Sorry, boss.
ja: ブレーク: 悪い、ボス。

key: MAXWELL: All right. You know our objective.
en: MAXWELL: All right. You know our objective.
ja: マクスウェル: よし。目的はわかってるな。

key: Let's make sure we get the last laugh on Aqua this time.
en: Let's make sure we get the last laugh on Aqua this time.
ja: 今回は、アクアに最後に笑ってやろうぜ。

key: DARM: Yea! See you at Ms. BLAH-dburry's house!
en: DARM: Yea! See you at Ms. BLAH-dburry's house!
ja: ダーム: よっしゃ! ブラーバリーさんとやらの家で会おう!

key: MAXWELL: Darm.
en: MAXWELL: Darm.
ja: マクスウェル: ダーム。

key: DARM: Sorry, boss.
en: DARM: Sorry, boss.
ja: ダーム: 悪い、ボス。

key: MAXWELL: We'll meet you there, \PN. Come soon.
en: MAXWELL: We'll meet you there, \PN. Come soon.
ja: マクスウェル: そこで落ち合おう、\PN。早めに来てくれ。

key: PIERCE: ...
en: PIERCE: ...
ja: ピアース: ……

key: BREAK: What do you get when you cross an Aqua Gang with a Magma Gang?
en: BREAK: What do you get when you cross an Aqua Gang with a Magma Gang?
ja: ブレーク: アクア団とマグマ団を掛け合わせると、何ができると思う?

key: Out of the way.
en: Out of the way.
ja: どけよ。

key: DEFACTO: The meeting should begin presently.
en: DEFACTO: The meeting should begin presently.
ja: デファクト: そろそろ会合が始まるはずだ。

key: DARM: Let us punch our way through their skulls! Or something!
en: DARM: Let us punch our way through their skulls! Or something!
ja: ダーム: 奴らの頭蓋骨をぶん殴って進もうぜ! とにかく何かしようぜ!

key: CRAUDBURRY: Hooligan thugs just knocked me out of the way... Somebody, please help!
en: CRAUDBURRY: Hooligan thugs just knocked me out of the way... Somebody, please help!
ja: クラウドバリー: ならず者たちに突き飛ばされたわ……誰か、助けて!

key: PIERCE: Go on, \PN.
en: PIERCE: Go on, \PN.
ja: ピアース: 行けよ、\PN。

key: DARM: Master MAN Darm strikes again! Take that, frail old lady!
en: DARM: Master MAN Darm strikes again! Take that, frail old lady!
ja: ダーム: マスター・マン、ダーム、再び参上! 食らえ、か弱き老婦人!

key: Yo, \PN, Aqua's already here! I gotta stay and make sure Ms. Cradblurry don't do anything sneaky, but you gotta go help!
en: Yo, \PN, Aqua's already here! I gotta stay and make sure Ms. Cradblurry don't do anything sneaky, but you gotta go help!
ja: よお\PN、アクアはもう来てるぞ! 俺はここに残って、あのクラッドバリーさんとやらがこそこそしないか見張るから、お前は助けに行ってくれ!

key: OFFICER: Pardon, a bit busy here.
en: OFFICER: Pardon, a bit busy here.
ja: 警官: 失礼、今立て込んでおりまして。

key: OFFICER: Oh my god, lady, shut up.
en: OFFICER: Oh my god, lady, shut up.
ja: 警官: ああもう、奥さん、黙ってください。

key: He appears to be sleeping.
en: He appears to be sleeping.
ja: 眠っているようだ。

key: I've been so worried about my husband... He's been sick for weeks, but nothing we do helps.
en: I've been so worried about my husband... He's been sick for weeks, but nothing we do helps.
ja: 夫のことがずっと心配で……もう何週間も具合が悪くて、何をしても良くならないの。

key: We've tried everything! Well, except--
en: We've tried everything! Well, except--
ja: 何もかも試したわ! まあ、ひとつを除いては――

key: No, no. That would be unthinkable.
en: No, no. That would be unthinkable.
ja: いえ、いえ。それは考えられないことだわ。

key: Never mind. I dare not even mention it.
en: Never mind. I dare not even mention it.
ja: いいの、忘れて。口に出す気にもなれないから。

key: Oh, it's you! Hello! My husband was cured almost immediately thanks to you.
en: Oh, it's you! Hello! My husband was cured almost immediately thanks to you.
ja: あら、あなただったのね! こんにちは! あなたのおかげで、夫はほとんどすぐに良くなったの。

key: It's a huge relief!
en: It's a huge relief!
ja: 本当にほっとしたわ!

key: Although I must admit, snooping around 7th Street was the most fun I've had in ages.
en: Although I must admit, snooping around 7th Street was the most fun I've had in ages.
ja: でも正直に言うと、7番街をこっそり歩き回るのは、久しぶりに楽しかったわ。

key: Maybe I'll go down again sometime.
en: Maybe I'll go down again sometime.
ja: また今度、行ってみようかしら。

key: Hey there. Can I interest you in some new moves?
en: Hey there. Can I interest you in some new moves?
ja: やあ。新しいわざ、興味ある?

key: You should have at least something that can learn these, right?
en: You should have at least something that can learn these, right?
ja: これを覚えられるポケモン、少なくとも一匹はいるだろ?

key: All right. For Water Pledge, I'm gonna need three Blue Shards.
en: All right. For Water Pledge, I'm gonna need three Blue Shards.
ja: よし。「みずのちかい」には、あおいかけらが3個必要だ。

key: Doesn't look like you've got the Shards though. I do need those for reasons. Come back when you've found them, 'kay?
en: Doesn't look like you've got the Shards though. I do need those for reasons. Come back when you've found them, 'kay?
ja: でも、かけらは持ってないみたいだな。ちょっと理由があって必要なんだ。見つけたらまた来てくれ、な?

key: Pleasure doing business.
en: Pleasure doing business.
ja: 取引できて何よりだ。

key: All right. For Fire Pledge, I'm gonna need three Red Shards.
en: All right. For Fire Pledge, I'm gonna need three Red Shards.
ja: よし。「ほのおのちかい」には、あかいかけらが3個必要だ。

key: All right. For Grass Pledge, I'm gonna need three Green Shards.
en: All right. For Grass Pledge, I'm gonna need three Green Shards.
ja: よし。「くさのちかい」には、みどりのかけらが3個必要だ。

key: By the way, the technique for these moves is a little different in Reborn than in other regions.
en: By the way, the technique for these moves is a little different in Reborn than in other regions.
ja: ちなみに、これらのわざのやり方は、リボーンでは他の地方とは少し違うんだ。

key: Where most Trainers come from, these moves only have unique effects in Double Battles...
en: Where most Trainers come from, these moves only have unique effects in Double Battles...
ja: 大抵のトレーナーの出身地では、これらのわざはダブルバトルでしか特殊な効果を発揮しないけど……

key: But in Reborn, if used in combination soon enough after each other, these moves can alter the terrain even in Single Battles!
en: But in Reborn, if used in combination soon enough after each other, these moves can alter the terrain even in Single Battles!
ja: リボーンでは、十分に間を置かずに組み合わせて使えば、シングルバトルでもフィールドを変化させられるんだ!

key: See you 'round.
en: See you 'round.
ja: またな。

key: I need an explanation as to why there is an IMMENSELY huge space where the level cap remains 35?
en: I need an explanation as to why there is an IMMENSELY huge space where the level cap remains 35?
ja: レベル制限が35のまま、とんでもなく広い空間があるのはなぜなのか、説明してほしいんだけど?

key: I tried to train up for the third Leader like I did for the second and first, because the difficulty got CLEARLY established.
en: I tried to train up for the third Leader like I did for the second and first, because the difficulty got CLEARLY established.
ja: 難易度がはっきり上がったから、一人目二人目のときと同じように、三人目のリーダーに備えて鍛えようとしたんだ。

key: Then I have to desperately try not to level up my Pokémon to have them listen to me?
en: Then I have to desperately try not to level up my Pokémon to have them listen to me?
ja: なのに、ポケモンに言うことを聞かせるために、必死にレベルを上げないようにしなきゃいけないわけ?

key: Why!?
en: Why!?
ja: なんで?!

key: WHY?!
en: WHY?!
ja: なんでよ?!

key: WHY DO ALL OF HER BUGS HAVE SO MUCH SPEED?!
en: WHY DO ALL OF HER BUGS HAVE SO MUCH SPEED?!
ja: なんであの人のむしポケモン、みんなあんなにすばやさ高いのよ?!

key: HOW IS IT THAT I AM SUPPOSED TO FIGHT HER IF MY LEVEL 35's CAN'T BEAT HER AND I'M NOT ALLOWED TO LEVEL THEM UP?
en: HOW IS IT THAT I AM SUPPOSED TO FIGHT HER IF MY LEVEL 35's CAN'T BEAT HER AND I'M NOT ALLOWED TO LEVEL THEM UP?
ja: レベル35じゃ勝てなくて、しかもレベルを上げちゃいけないなら、一体どうやって戦えっていうのよ?

key: I'm-- I'm sorry for my frustration.
en: I'm-- I'm sorry for my frustration.
ja: ご、ごめん、いらいらしちゃって。

key: Just-- Just take this.
en: Just-- Just take this.
ja: とにかく――これ、受け取って。

key: I'm sorry, I just need answers...
en: I'm sorry, I just need answers...
ja: ごめん、ただ答えが欲しいだけなんだ……

key: Water Pledge
en: Water Pledge
ja: みずのちかい

key: Fire Pledge
en: Fire Pledge
ja: ほのおのちかい

key: Grass Pledge
en: Grass Pledge
ja: くさのちかい

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
